name: dgcluster
reference: Bhowmick, Meneni, Derr, et al. DGCluster: A Neural Framework for Attributed Graph Clustering via Modularity Maximization. AAAI 2024.

upstream.note: Clone + separate driver, no patch: the GNN encoder and modularity loss_fn (main.py) are imported unchanged and main.py/utils.py are left pristine. run_dgcluster.py sets the module globals loss_fn reads and runs training. We run DGCluster unsupervised by overriding its label-based auxiliary objective to zero (it is semi-supervised by default); the override lives in the driver, not the authors' files.
upstream.unsupervised: DGCluster's aux objective uses ground-truth labels; disabled so the comparison stays structural.

base_model.doc: Message-passing backbone. Settable per graph class but excluded from tuning.

feature_kind.doc: Synthetic node representation used only when the instance has no real features.

threshold.doc: Birch distance threshold; the granularity knob (lower yields more clusters). DGCluster takes no target k.
